title: Pomp
summary: POMP, noun [Latin pompa; bombus; Eng. bomb, bombast.] 1. A procession distinguished by ostentation of grandeur and splendor; as the pomp of a Roman triumph. 2. Show of magnificence; parade; splendor.

inlines.v: POMP, noun [Latin pompa; bombus; Eng. bomb, bombast.] 1. A procession distinguished by ostentation of grandeur and splendor; as the pomp of a Roman triumph. 2. Show of magnificence; parade; splendor. Hearts formed for love, but doom'd in vain to glow In prison'd pomp and weep in splendid woe.
